fix.shows: Reports a review of ECINET's publicly served code by Saurav Rajput, a data scientist at the civic-tech initiative Charchagram, which found a rule that can bar registration officers in West Bengal from the page that shows each enumeration form with its documents and from the notice-and-hearing dashboard, and found no such rule for any other state. The review read only the code a browser receives before login, so it cannot say whether the rule was used or enforced on the server, and the paper says it could not verify the review. The Commission did not answer the paper's questions.
